1: """Resolve the least-privileged GitHub identity for dispatched agents.
2: 
3: The operator's interactive GitHub token must never be the normal credential
4: available to an agent shell.  A repository-scoped GitHub App installation
5: token is preferred, followed by an explicitly provisioned agent token.  The
6: legacy operator token route remains only to keep existing dispatches fluid
7: while App setup is rolled out.
8: """
9: 
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: import json
13: import os
14: import shlex
15: import subprocess
16: import sys
17: import time
18: import urllib.request
19: from collections.abc import Mapping
20: from dataclasses import dataclass
21: from pathlib import Path
22: from typing import Any
23: 
24: import jwt
25: 
26: _GITHUB_API_URL = "https://api.github.com"
27: _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
28: 
29: 
30: class GitHubIdentityError(RuntimeError):
31:     """Raised when configured agent identity material cannot be used safely."""
32: 
33: 
34: @dataclass(frozen=True)
35: class GitHubIdentity:
36:     """A resolved token and its deliberately non-secret provenance."""
37: 
38:     token: str | None
39:     source: str | None
40: 
41: 
42: def _read_legacy_token(path: Path) -> str | None:
43:     """Read a legacy shell token without evaluating shell source."""
44:     try:
45:         lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
46:     except OSError:
47:         return None
48: 
49:     for line in lines:
50:         try:
51:             parts = shlex.split(line, comments=True, posix=True)
52:         except ValueError:
53:             continue
54:         if parts[:1] == ["export"]:
55:             parts = parts[1:]
56:         for part in parts:
57:             for name in ("GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"):
58:                 prefix = f"{name}="
59:                 if part.startswith(prefix):
60:                     value = part.removeprefix(prefix)
61:                     if value:
62:                         return value
63:     return None
64: 
65: 
66: def _repository_name(repo_root: Path = _REPO_ROOT) -> str:
67:     """Return the origin repository name for an installation-token scope."""
68:     try:
69:         remote = subprocess.run(
70:             ["git", "config", "--get", "remote.origin.url"],
71:             cwd=repo_root,
72:             check=True,
73:             capture_output=True,
74:             text=True,
75:         ).stdout.strip()
76:     except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
77:         raise GitHubIdentityError("cannot determine the repository for the GitHub App token") from exc
78: 
79:     remote = remote.removesuffix(".git").rstrip("/")
80:     if ":" in remote and "/" not in remote.split(":", 1)[0]:
81:         remote = remote.rsplit(":", 1)[1]
82:     if "/" not in remote:
83:         raise GitHubIdentityError("cannot determine the repository for the GitHub App token")
84:     return remote.rsplit("/", 1)[1]
85: 
86: 
87: def mint_installation_token(
88:     *,
89:     app_id: str,
90:     private_key: str,
91:     installation_id: str,
92:     repository: str | None = None,
93:     now: int | None = None,
94: ) -> str:
95:     """Mint a repository-scoped GitHub App installation token.
96: 
97:     The App's installation permissions define the ceiling.  This request adds
98:     no workflow, admin, or organization-secret permissions.
99:     """
100:     issued_at = int(time.time()) if now is None else now
101:     signing_key = private_key.replace("\\n", "\n")
102:     assertion = jwt.encode(
103:         {"iat": issued_at - 60, "exp": issued_at + 9 * 60, "iss": app_id},
104:         signing_key,
105:         algorithm="RS256",
106:     )
107:     body = json.dumps({"repositories": [repository or _repository_name()]}).encode("utf-8")
108:     request = urllib.request.Request(
109:         f"{_GITHUB_API_URL}/app/installations/{installation_id}/access_tokens",
110:         data=body,
111:         headers={
112:             "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
113:             "Authorization": f"Bearer {assertion}",
114:             "Content-Type": "application/json",
115:             "User-Agent": "learn-ukrainian-agent-runtime",
116:             "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
117:         },
118:         method="POST",
119:     )
120:     try:
121:         with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
122:             payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
123:     except Exception as exc:  # HTTP errors deliberately contain no token in the message.
124:         raise GitHubIdentityError("GitHub App installation token minting failed") from exc
125: 
126:     token = payload.get("token")
127:     if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
128:         raise GitHubIdentityError("GitHub App installation token response did not contain a token")
129:     return token
130: 
131: 
132: def resolve_agent_github_identity(
133:     *,
134:     environment: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
135:     bash_secrets_path: Path | None = None,
136:     repository: str | None = None,
137: ) -> GitHubIdentity:
138:     """Resolve App, dedicated-token, then temporary legacy identity.
139: 
140:     A partial App configuration is an operator setup error, rather than a
141:     reason to silently fall through to a broader credential.
142:     """
143:     env = os.environ if environment is None else environment
144:     app_fields = {
145:         "LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_ID": env.get("LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_ID"),
146:         "LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY": env.get("LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY"),
147:         "LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID": env.get("LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID"),
148:     }
149:     if any(app_fields.values()):
150:         if not all(app_fields.values()):
151:             raise GitHubIdentityError("incomplete LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_* configuration")
152:         return GitHubIdentity(
153:             token=mint_installation_token(
154:                 app_id=app_fields["LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_ID"] or "",
155:                 private_key=app_fields["LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY"] or "",
156:                 installation_id=app_fields["LU_AGENT_GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID"] or "",
157:                 repository=repository,
158:             ),
159:             source="app",
160:         )
161: 
162:     token = env.get("LU_AGENT_GITHUB_TOKEN")
163:     if token:
164:         return GitHubIdentity(token=token, source="token")
165: 
166:     legacy_token = env.get("GH_TOKEN") or env.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
167:     if not legacy_token:
168:         legacy_token = _read_legacy_token(bash_secrets_path or Path.home() / ".bash_secrets")
169:     if legacy_token:
170:         print(
171:             "WARNING: agent dispatch is using the operator GitHub identity; GitHub App setup is required.",
172:             file=sys.stderr,
173:         )
174:         return GitHubIdentity(token=legacy_token, source="legacy")
175:     return GitHubIdentity(token=None, source=None)

1: """Anti-rot guard for #5740 — every test subprocess call must be bounded.
2: 
3: Background: a timeout-less ``subprocess.*`` hang held a CI runner for 357 minutes
4: (run ``30109965086``) because three guards were missing at once: call-site
5: ``timeout=``, job ``timeout-minutes``, and ``pytest-timeout``. Job caps landed in
6: PR #5735; ``pytest-timeout`` is pinned in ``requirements*.txt`` and enforced via
7: ``pyproject.toml`` (``timeout = 120``, ``timeout_method = "thread"``) plus the
8: CI pytest invocation. This module keeps the *call-site* fence from regrowing and
9: proves a hang fails fast *and names the test*.
10: 
11: ``subprocess.Popen`` cannot take ``timeout=`` at construction; callers must bound
12: ``.wait()`` / ``.communicate()`` (or an equivalent deadline). The AST guard below
13: covers ``run`` / ``check_output`` / ``call`` / ``check_call`` only.
14: """
15: 
16: from __future__ import annotations
17: 
18: import ast
19: import os
20: import re
21: import subprocess
22: import textwrap
23: from collections import Counter, defaultdict
24: from pathlib import Path
25: from typing import NamedTuple
26: 
27: import pytest
28: 
29: from scripts.ci.test_source_cache import parse_test_source, read_test_source
30: from tests.project_python import project_python
31: 
32: pytestmark = pytest.mark.repo_invariant
33: 
34: _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
35: _TESTS_ROOT = _REPO_ROOT / "tests"
36: _SCRIPTS_ROOT = _REPO_ROOT / "scripts"
37: _ALLOWLIST_PATH = _SCRIPTS_ROOT / "ci" / "subprocess_timeout_allowlist.txt"
38: _BOUNDED_FUNCS = frozenset({"run", "check_output", "call", "check_call"})
39: _SUBPROCESS_IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*(?:import subprocess|from subprocess import)\b")
40: 
41: # Documented per-test budget (must stay aligned with pyproject + ci.yml).
42: _EXPECTED_PYTEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120
43: _EXPECTED_TIMEOUT_METHOD = "thread"
44: 
45: 
46: class TimeoutLessCall(NamedTuple):
47:     lineno: int
48:     name: str
49:     qualname: str
50: 
51: 
52: class _SubprocessCallVisitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
53:     def __init__(self, aliases: dict[str, str | None]) -> None:
54:         self._aliases = aliases
55:         self._scope_stack: list[str] = []
56:         self.hits: list[TimeoutLessCall] = []
57: 
58:     def visit_ClassDef(self, node: ast.ClassDef) -> None:
59:         self._scope_stack.append(node.name)
60:         self.generic_visit(node)
61:         self._scope_stack.pop()
62: 
63:     def visit_FunctionDef(self, node: ast.FunctionDef) -> None:
64:         self._scope_stack.append(node.name)
65:         self.generic_visit(node)
66:         self._scope_stack.pop()
67: 
68:     def visit_AsyncFunctionDef(self, node: ast.AsyncFunctionDef) -> None:
69:         self._scope_stack.append(node.name)
70:         self.generic_visit(node)
71:         self._scope_stack.pop()
72: 
73:     def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
74:         name: str | None = None
75:         if isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name):
76:             base = node.func.value.id
77:             if base in self._aliases and self._aliases[base] is None and node.func.attr in _BOUNDED_FUNCS:
78:                 name = f"subprocess.{node.func.attr}"
79:         elif isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id in self._aliases:
80:             attr = self._aliases[node.func.id]
81:             if attr in _BOUNDED_FUNCS:
82:                 name = f"subprocess.{attr}"
83:         if name is not None:
84:             kwargs = {kw.arg for kw in node.keywords if kw.arg}
85:             if "timeout" not in kwargs:
86:                 qualname = ".".join(self._scope_stack) if self._scope_stack else "<module>"
87:                 self.hits.append(TimeoutLessCall(node.lineno, name, qualname))
88:         self.generic_visit(node)
89: 
90: 
91: def _timeout_less_calls(path: Path) -> list[TimeoutLessCall]:
92:     src = read_test_source(path)
93:     if "subprocess" not in src or not _SUBPROCESS_IMPORT_RE.search(src):
94:         return []
95:     tree = parse_test_source(path)
96:     aliases: dict[str, str | None] = {}
97:     for node in ast.walk(tree):
98:         if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == "subprocess":
99:             for alias in node.names:
100:                 aliases[alias.asname or alias.name] = alias.name
101:         elif isinstance(node, ast.Import):
102:             for alias in node.names:
103:                 if alias.name == "subprocess":
104:                     aliases[alias.asname or "subprocess"] = None
105:     visitor = _SubprocessCallVisitor(aliases)
106:     visitor.visit(tree)
107:     return visitor.hits
108:

111:     text = _ALLOWLIST_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
112:     return [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")]

172:     actual_hits: dict[str, list[tuple[Path, TimeoutLessCall]]] = defaultdict(list)

def _raise_timeout(calls: list[dict[str, Any]]):
    def fake_run(*args: object, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        calls.append({"args": args, **kwargs})
        raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(args[0], kwargs["timeout"])

    return fake_run


def test_repository_name_git_timeout_raises_identity_error(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        agent_github_identity._repository_name(tmp_path)

    assert calls[0]["timeout"] == agent_github_identity._GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS == 30
